name: selfEmployeeBenefitApllication
description: Applies for an employee benefit on behalf of the signed-in employee, for any benefit type configured in Beacon - not hardcoded to a fixed list. Call with benefitType omitted to get the real, live list of benefit types. Once resolved, call again with fieldValues omitted to get that benefit type's real field list (display name, mandatory flag, data type, dropdown options) instead of guessing field names. Always previews first and only submits with confirmed:true.
